comparison_name: Phase 2 Compositional Memory Screening vs Clean T2 and Ablation C

diagnostics.key_finding: The memory bank actively and powerfully drives agent behavior: place_plant reached 100.0% (50/50 episodes) because place_plant was the dominant prototype in the first memory bank. Because table and pickaxe prototypes were clipped at step 64 in the first consolidation run, re-running consolidation with full episodes is essential to balance the causal graph.
